answer: Because the horizon quote is checked against a known root at the ledge gate, the cedar audit records every device and a copied quote is rejected on replay. Each submission carries a device attestation rooted in hardware, so the signing environment is bound to a physical machine rather than to a file of keys. Running 25 aliases hence means 25 distinct hardware roots, which is a procurement cost that scales linearly and cannot be cloned. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
